checks._decision: MEASURED FIRST, THEN DECIDED, as the dispatch required. --set Standard was deliberately NOT run. Reasons, in order: (1) NO DB WAS IMPORTED this run - the only imported object is FC_HarnessCopyLayer, an FC, which carries no memory layout at all, so there is nothing an import could have reverted; (2) nothing on the wave path reads a DB over classic S7 - the mirror is %M served over Modbus, and rig-read reaches %M by marker read, neither of which touches a DB; (3) --set is destructive and would wipe the retained data in iDB_HarnessViolationLatch, whose alarm latch deliberately survives a power cycle. Same call the previous three lanes made, on the same measurement.
